title: Autoroute: Friendly URLs for Your Content Items | Orchard Core
description:
Without Autoroute, Orchard Core displays a content item at an address that ends with the identifier of the item, a long string of letters and digits that visitors can't read, remember, or guess.

The Autoroute module gives a content item a permalink, generated from a pattern that usually uses the title. You attach the Autoroute part to a content type, choose what its editors can do, and keep, refresh, or write the permalink of each item.

In this video:
• Why Autoroute
• Add Autoroute to a content type
• Choose the Autoroute settings
• Create a content item
• Change a permalink
